impact: A sign the farm and industrial cycle is turning down; little direct effect on Clement's holdings.
summary: Deere's fiscal Q4 EPS of $3.89 missed the $4.07 consensus, though revenue of $12.12 billion, down 2% year over year, beat the $10.4 billion estimate. It forecast fiscal 2027 net income of $4.50 billion to $5.25 billion, with large agriculture weakness weighing. Shares fell over 3% premarket.
title: Deere misses at $3.89 EPS on farm weakness, shares down over 3%
